sentences.text: 1  HIGH COURT OF CHHATTISGARH, BILASPUR  Order Sheet  CRA No. 256 of 2020  Prabhakar Khobragadhe S/o Tulshiram Khobragadhe Aged About 24 Years  R/o Indira Nagar, Ward No. - 05, Near Ravi Kirana Shop, Dongargarh, Police  Station - Dongargarh, District - Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh.

---- Appellant  Versus  State of Chhattisgarh Through The Station House Officer, Police Station -  Dongargarh, District - Rajnandgaon, C.G.
 ---- Respondent 12.07.2024
Mr. B.P. Singh, counsel for the Appellant.
Ms. Monika Thakur, P.L. for the State/Respondent.
Heard on I.A. No.04/2024, this is repeat application under Section 389 of CrPC for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
This is admitted appeal.

By the impugned judgment dated 29.01.2020 passed in Special Criminal Case No.08/2019 by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Dongargarh, District - Rajnandgaon (C.G.), the appellant stands convicted and sentenced as mentioned below:
 Conviction Sentence In Default Under Section RI for 10 years and In default of payment of  fine amount of fine amount additional 376(2)() of IPC  Rs.1,000/- RI for 02 months Prabhakar Khobragadhe vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18302524/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has been wrongly convicted by the trial Court in the judgment without there being any sufficient and clinching evidence available on record.

He further submits that the trial Court has failed to appreciate the evidence of Dr. Khusboo Dewangan (PW-3) who specifically stated that she was medically examined to the prosecutrix (PW-6) and she found that there was no external or internal injury over the body of the prosecutrix and she further stated that there was no sign regarding sexual intercourse over the body of prosecutrix.
He further stated that there is delay in lodging the FIR about more than one month from the date of alleged incident.
He also submits that the appellant is in jail since 17.05.2019 and he has been completed more than five years jail sentence out of 10 years of jail sentence imposed upon him by the trial Court.

Looking to these facts, it is good case in favour of the appellant,
therefore, it is prayed that the sentence imposed upon him by the trial Court may be suspended and he may be released from jail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the argument advanced by the learned counsel for the appellant.
I have heard learned counsel appearing for the parties and perused the judgment of the trial Court and other material available on record with utmost circumspection.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, perused the entire evidence adduced by the prosecution, considering the age of the victim at the time of incident, the victim was aged about 16 years and the appellant was aged about 24 years and he is already been married person.
On perusal of record of the trail Court in which it is mentioned that the appellant took the victim to the hotel and forcibly established physical relation with her.

When she refused the appellant, the appellant said that he had made a video of the first time he had made physical relation with her, if she refuse then he will tell everyone due to which her parents will commit suicide themselves and he had threatened her to kill her parents.
I am of the view that it is not a fit case for grant of bail to appellant during the pendency of this appeal.
Accordingly, I.A. No.04/2024 is rejected.
List this case for final hearing in its due course.
